images.title: Street corner with the stone block around the entrance in blue-teal
images.author: Edited from Wilming et al. (2017), Osnabrück–Hamburg eye-tracking database
images.changes: Recoloured by rule with tools/comparisons/recolour.py (prompt 071): the rusticated stone block around the entrance, from the balcony slab to the pavement, in blue-teal, keeping the stone's lightness; the door, steps, sign and plants unchanged; outside the block only JPEG re-encoding noise (mean 0.5 of 255 levels). Saved as JPEG
